description: Run the open Curbi Proof verifier (curbi.proof/0.1) on a bundle with the public keys you choose: signatures, key windows, RFC 9162 inclusion under the signed log head, attestation binding and history consistency. Keys are required and are the trust anchor; keys inside the bundle are never trusted here. Test keys verify only with allowTest. Also accepts bounded TEST browser gate proofs with separately pinned request/trust and archival time. Pure computation: no network, nothing stored. A verified bundle shows what a trusted key signed and logged; it does not show that the provider action happened, and grants no authority.

bundle.description: A curbi.proof/0.1 bundle, or curbi.browser.gate-proof.v1 wrapper with result and proposal, to verify.

keys.description: Caller-pinned JWKS. For a gate-proof wrapper: curbi.browser.gate-trust.v1 with identity, policy, registry, minVersion, log, optional previous, and explicit ISO at for archival mode.

known.description: Log heads you saw before, to check the log is append-only.

mode.description: "fresh" also checks keys are currently valid; "archival" checks them at signing time.

name: verify_bundle
title: Verify a Curbi proof bundle offline
